name: agent-verification-kit
description: Test automation and verification for agentic coding. Ships hooks, not only skills — a skill is advice, a hook is a gate.

plugins.name: agent-verification-kit
plugins.description: Evidence-required completion, enforced outside the agent's own judgement rather than by instructing it. A commit is blocked unless a fresh verification stamp exists; the stamp is written only by a passing test or build command, is scoped to the repository being committed to, expires after 30 minutes, and is cleared by any file edit. Modifying an existing test or test config requires a declaration naming that path, so weakening a suite is deliberate rather than silent. It also ships a flake-triage layer meant to stamp a re-run pass as flaky rather than clean, which as of 2026-09-06 DOES NOT FIRE - the harness sends no PostToolUse event for a failing command, so no failure is ever recorded (INC-0024). It is documented in the README as inert rather than removed, because deleting it would hide the failure. Also validates that every agent definition in a commit names a model that actually resolves, because a typo'd model: does not fail at runtime — it 404s, retries, and silently falls back to the dispatching session's model. Governs Claude Code only; it is accident prevention inside one harness, not a security boundary.
